_doc: The host's lines in the trailer (compositions TrailerFilm, Trailer and TrailerAnimatic; plan: docs/notes/2026-11-26-trailer-plan.md). Same fields as narration.drama.json ('text' caption, 'say' spoken form) plus 'en' (the English caption under it) and an optional 'rate' for one beat. The voice is the drama version's. 'npm run tts:trailer' reads it into public/narration-trailer/<scene>_<k>.mp3; a scene's id is the scene the line is spoken in, and where it sits on the clock is in src/trailer/timing.ts.

beats.text: LLM 오징어 게임에 오신 걸 환영합니다.
beats.say: 엘엘엠 오징어 게임에 오신 걸 환영합니다.
beats.en: Welcome to the LLM Squid Game.
You must survive on your tokens,

beats.text: 게임에 완주 시 상금 2,000만 토큰을 나누어 가집니다.
beats.say: 게임에 완주 시, 상금 이천만 토큰을 나누어 가집니다.
beats.en: and those who finish the game share a prize of 20 million tokens.
Will you help the one beside you?
Will you stay together to the end?
